'''Cahel Tse''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] serving the fledgling [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during its first days on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]]. He was an apprentice of Master [[Rajivari]] and became one of his devout followers. Along with a number of other apprentices trained by Rajivari, he abandoned the Order when Rajivari renounced his oath to the Order he helped found circa [[25,783 BBY]]. Taking up residence in the fortress city of [[Kaleth]], Cahel and the followers of Rajivari were encountered by an army of [[Flesh Raider]]s.<ref name="TOR" />
